chunks: Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said:
One who recites the Azaan for seven years, sincerely seeking reward from Allah alone, will appear on the Day of Judgment without any sin to his name.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for reciting the Azaan for seven years with sincerity?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) linking the consistent recitation of the Azaan for seven years to the complete erasure of sins, a reward rooted in the high status of the call to prayer in Shia jurisprudence. This practice is viewed not merely as a ritual but as a continuous act of public worship (ikhlas) that purifies the soul, ensuring the believer stands before Allah free from minor and major sins. The emphasis on the seven-year period reflects the traditional understanding of a complete cycle of spiritual discipline in early Islamic communities.
